mainEntity.name: Do you offer online or in-person options?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary beginners course runs as weekly in-person classes in Coventry, combining classroom teaching with practical local shoots — the immediate feedback accelerates learning. Online mentoring support is included between sessions for questions and homework feedback, and fully online routes exist too: 1-2-1 online lessons or the free online course .

mainEntity.name: I'm a complete beginner — is that OK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — the beginners classes are designed for complete beginners through to those already gaining confidence with basic settings. No prior knowledge is assumed.
Weekly 2-hour sessions over 3 weeks, in small groups capped at four, with practice tasks between classes so each idea gets used on your own camera before the next session.

mainEntity.name: What if I can't get to Coventry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose online 1-2-1 lessons for live personal teaching over Zoom, or start with the free online course and add support when you need it.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for my first lesson?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring your camera (any make), its battery charged, and — most usefully — a handful of your own photos you like or are frustrated by. Frame your goals around techniques you want to learn rather than gear you think you need; skills, not equipment, are what move beginners forward.
